base.label: Delayed FID; partial option recognition
base.notes: Wheeler River FID slips beyond 2030; equity funds burn at ~CAD 60-70M/year operating cash use; terminal price embeds modest uranium sentiment but no full project NPV

bear.label: Permit/funding failure; dilution
bear.notes: Wheeler River does not reach production; cash competes with reclamation/JV calls; meaningful dilution to ~1.1B shares; uranium price reverts while burn continues

bull.label: FID + construction; uranium upcycle
bull.notes: Positive FID on Phoenix ISR with constructive uranium term pricing; McClean Lake tolling path preserved; share count contained near 920M

growth_explanation.mechanism: No normalized owner-cash growth path; return is entirely a function of Wheeler River development milestones, uranium price, and dilution.

paths.label: Growth theory (pre-falsifier)

weight_falsifiers: Included at full weight alongside falsifier-adjusted without divergence note

paths.label: Bear scenario (Lawrence)
paths.weight_why: Downside stress; low weight because bear is a sensitivity, not a competing explanation of base mechanics.
weight_falsifiers: Bear assumptions become base case in filings (e.g. sustained volume collapse)
paths.hard_to_vary: yes: asymmetric low weight is structural

paths.label: Bull scenario (Lawrence)

weight_falsifiers: Bull growth sustained in filings for 4+ quarters without falsifier trigger
